desc: Premier CuT's monolithic copper alloy bullet gives high accuracy and terminal performance across all hunting ranges. Maximize your aerodynamic efficiency and weight retention with optimal penetration, lead-free. Loaded with Remington's best components, Premier CuT is your new copper tipped option for ultimate precision. Available in a lineup of popular big game centerfire cartridges, including 6.5 PRC, 7 PRC and 300 PRC.
